decision_rule: Per explicit user instruction: freeze as ESCONV_AUXILIARY_ABSOLUTE_LABEL_INSTRUMENT_NOT_SUPPORTED if, after (a) the judge-uncertainty-robust MAD-adjusted conservative utility (lambda=1.0 fixed), (b) risk-head action-applicability zero-weighting, (c) sparse-zero-aware informative-only duplicate/correlation detection, (d) pairwise action-applicable-row restriction for risk-dimension correlation, and (e) directional (positive/negative) splitting of the correlation gate are all applied, the applicable response dimensions and the cross-judge-family routing preference remain unreliable. Both conditions hold here; do not continue adjusting thresholds, lambda, or applicability definitions.

response_dimension_low_mad_coverage_unre.note: response.factual_grounding and response.memory_appropriateness are always-applicable response dimensions (no structural-zero exemption is possible for them); low judge agreement here is a genuine, unresolved measurement-reliability limitation, not an artifact of sparsity or applicability.

google_gemini_near_constant_and_duplicat.note: gemini shows near-zero variance on response.temporal_consistency, risk.memory_omission and risk.strategy_overuse, a near-duplicate between response.factual_grounding/response.temporal_consistency (99.06% exact match), and near-zero risk signal on the M0+RS panel. All three risk dimensions here are genuinely applicable to M0+RS, so none of this is explained by the applicability contract.

cross_judge_routing_preference_unreliabl.note: Among the 318 M0+R0-vs-M0+RS comparable states, 52.5% involve at least one family reporting a tie, and among the 151 decisive (non-tie) comparisons the two independent judge families agree on direction only 64.2% of the time (90% dialogue-clustered bootstrap CI [0.577, 0.709]) -- a materially unreliable cross-family signal on exactly the R0-vs-RS distinction this instrument exists to measure.

sparse_zero_and_applicability_fixes_conf.note: The sparse-zero informative-only fix removed the previously-reported deepseek_official unsupported_personal_claim/strategy_omission false-positive duplicate. The new pairwise action-applicability restriction plus positive/negative correlation split correctly reclassified the deepseek_official strategy_overuse/strategy_omission near-perfect anti-correlation (informative_correlation=-1.0 on the 318 M0+RS-applicable rows) as a mutual_exclusivity_diagnostic_pair (reported, not gating), and deepseek_official now PASSES its own raw-family-global gate entirely. These confirmed-working fixes remove every false-positive/structural finding identified so far, but the remaining findings above are genuine and unresolved by any measurement-contract adjustment.
